reusable_lessons: A builder should recover durable repository state before trusting an incomplete conversational handoff.
Expensive evaluation should bind to exact checkpoint and data lineage before accelerator use.
A successful evaluator process is not the same as a successful behavioral gate; receipts must encode that distinction explicitly.
Held-out dev performance can choose where to investigate next but does not replace genuinely novel challenge cases.
Previously learned infrastructure failures are part of builder knowledge and should become hard non-regression constraints rather than experiments that get repeated.
